item.title: Morning Weather for Thursday, September 03
item.description: Good morning! Let's find out what the weather is like on this Thursday, September 3. It's Thursday, almost the end of the week. Here in Shanghai, the day will be thundery. The high will be 30 degrees, and the low will be 25 degrees. There is a 97 percent chance of rain. Pack your umbrella and your wellies! Rainy days are good for staying in. Maybe we can build a den with the blankets. Looking ahead to tomorrow, it will be drizzly, reaching 31 degrees. A question for you: what are you looking forward to? That's your weather. Have a wonderful day!
